_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Spare Parts Delivery Status (SPDS)
summary: The Spare Parts Delivery Status (SPDS) gives logisticians, program managers, and other stakeholders a consolidated list of spare parts procured on a contract and their delivery status.
use_relationship:
The Spare Parts Delivery Status (SPDS) will provide logisticians, program managers, and other stakeholders with a consolidated list of spare parts procured on a contract and their delivery status. SPDS data are used to manage and track parts deliveries. These data may be obtained during any program life cycle phase.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use of information for the data product resulting from the work task described by the contract SOW.
This DID supersedes DI-PSSS-82234.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Contractor's format is acceptable. The SPDS shall be in a format similar to that of Figure 1. Separate tabs may be used to denote separate contract actions or fiscal years.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The SPDS shall contain all of the information specified in Figure 1. All fields shall be included. Fields which do not require data shall be left blank. The information shall be included for all spare parts procured on the contract. If the same part number is delivered in separate shipments, separate lines shall be used. Additional information or color coding may be included if necessary to accurately communicate spare parts delivery status. All color coding shall be defined by a key included in the document.

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirement:
preparation_instructions.content: The SPDS shall be provided as an electronically editable file compatible with Microsoft Excel.
